name: Nyuugaku Omedetou ~Hajimete wa Osananajimi~
original_name: 入学おめでとう ～はじめては幼馴染～
source:
Protagonist Takahiro has been working for two years.
On his day off he's lazing around the house when an old childhood playmate,
the perky girl next door named Nao, comes to play.

It's been a long time since Takahiro saw Nao,
and she's surprisingly mature!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ051293.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
主角贵宏已经工作两年了。
休息日，他在屋子里闲逛，这时一位儿时的老玩伴，
活泼的邻家女孩娜奥来玩。

贵宏已经很久没有见到奈绪了，
而且她出奇的成熟！

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ051293.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
